issues.legal_issue: Maintenance expenditure on immature trees in an income-producing plantation is deductible even when those trees yield no income in the accounting year.
material_facts: The taxpayer operated rubber plantations containing both mature, yielding trees and immature trees that had not begun to yield rubber.
The taxpayer incurred expenditure on the upkeep and maintenance of the immature trees.
The expenditure was wholly and exclusively incurred for deriving agricultural income, and was not disputed to be so.
The immature trees produced no return in the accounting years in question.
issues.conclusion: The expenditure on maintaining the immature trees was a permissible deduction, notwithstanding that those trees produced no income in the relevant accounting year.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 5 of the Travancore-Cochin Agricultural Income-tax Act, 1950, expenditure other than capital expenditure or personal expenses, laid out wholly and exclusively for deriving agricultural income, is deductible. The deduction is not limited to expenditure that produces a return in the same accounting year. The Court followed Vallambrosa Rubber Co. Ltd. v. Farmer, (1910) 5 T.C. 529, and held Assam Bengal Cement Co. Ltd. v. Commissioner of Income-tax, West Bengal, [1955] 1 S.C.R. 972, inapplicable because that case concerned capital expenditure incurred to acquire an income-earning asset.

rule.if: agricultural_income_tax_deduction_claim and plantation_has_yielding_trees_and_immature_trees and maintenance_expense_incurred_for_immature_trees and expense_wholly_and_exclusively_for_deriving_income and not capital_or_personal_expense and immature_trees_yield_no_current_income

predicates.agricultural_income_tax_deduction_claim: A taxpayer seeks a deduction in a proceeding concerning the calculation of agricultural income for tax purposes.
predicates.plantation_has_yielding_trees_and_immatu: The taxpayer's income-producing plantation contains both trees that yield produce and immature trees that have not begun to yield produce.
predicates.maintenance_expense_incurred_for_immatur: The taxpayer incurs expenditure to maintain or tend the immature trees.
predicates.expense_wholly_and_exclusively_for_deriv: The taxpayer incurs the expenditure wholly and exclusively for the purpose of deriving agricultural income.
predicates.not capital_or_personal_expense: The expenditure is neither capital expenditure nor a personal expense of the taxpayer.
predicates.immature_trees_yield_no_current_income: The immature trees produce no income during the accounting year for which the deduction is claimed.
predicates.deduction_allowed: The expenditure is deductible in calculating agricultural income.

issues.definition: When a taxpayer claims an agricultural-income deduction for noncapital, nonpersonal expenditure incurred wholly and exclusively to derive income by maintaining immature trees in a plantation that also has yielding trees, the expenditure is deductible even if the immature trees yield no income in that accounting year.
